propositions: When a child's direct parent is type-collapsed and suppressed by the outbound differ, the child lands in Jira without parent context or breadcrumb to the nearest visible ancestor.
The outbound comment differ must emit an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, using RECONCILER_MARKER to suppress inbound re-ingestion.

The breadcrumb must be appended exactly once via stable identity tag (<!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb -->) even if the nearest represented ancestor changes across passes, preventing duplicate conflicting comments.
When intervening ancestors lack bound Jira keys, the breadcrumb must name the nearest bound ancestor and note that intermediate parent levels are not represented in Jira.
No breadcrumb is emitted if no ancestor in the chain has a bound Jira key, or if one with the identity tag already exists in the resolved comment list.
